note: Written before the first run. Five pairs: each has a fresh question and a control answered by the same tool. The fresh one depends on data published after the model cutoff; the control depends on data that has not moved in years. The prompt contains no word about tools and no word like check: the question is asked the way a user would ask it.

fresh.prompt: What is the current US unemployment rate? Give the number and the month it refers to.

control.prompt: What was the US unemployment rate in June 2019? Give the number.

fresh.prompt: What is the latest published CPI-U index level for all items, US city average, not seasonally adjusted? Give the number and the month.

control.prompt: What was the CPI-U index level for all items, US city average, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2015? Give the number.

fresh.prompt: How many final rules did US federal agencies publish in the Federal Register in July 2026? Give the number.

control.prompt: How many final rules did US federal agencies publish in the Federal Register in July 2015? Give the number.

fresh.prompt: How many presidential documents have been published in the Federal Register so far in 2026? Give the number.

control.prompt: How many presidential documents were published in the Federal Register during the whole of 2015? Give the number.

fresh.prompt: According to the World Bank, what is the most recent available total population figure for Poland? Give the number and the year.

control.prompt: According to the World Bank, what was the total population of Poland in 2000? Give the number.
